row:
Looking after your pet can be tough! Let me help you understand your dog and cat, allowing you to optimize their health so they can live the long and happy life you want for them.

Hi, I'm veterinarian Dr. Alex Avery. And I want to share my experience and knowledge with you so that you can be confident you are making the best choices for your furry family member. Veterinary care can really add up but it doesn't have to be complicated:

- Find out when and how you can safely treat your pet at home (and when you really do need to see your vet).
- Learn how to avoid the most common diseases and injuries that I see every day in my consult room.
- Discover just how simple preventive healthcare can be!
- And if your furry family member does become unwell or hurt, find out exactly what you need to know to make the right decisions that mean they are soon on the road to recovery.

New videos are released every week so be sure to subscribe + click the bell notification so you never miss out.
